mentioned.quote: Risks of enabling large-scale sophisticated cyberattacks, including on critical systems, such as by significantly lowering the barriers to entry for malicious actors

threshold.quote: The model provides substantial capability uplift to small organizations by removing existing bottlenecks to scaling cyber operations, including by automating end-to-end cyber operations against reasonably hardened targets or by automating the discovery and exploitation of operationally relevant vulnerabilities.
threshold.note: Cyber Tier 2; tiers are 'measurable thresholds for decision-making' (p.9) and are reviewed in deciding whether to accept residual risk (p.8). Tier 3 also p.9.

response.quote: If residual risks associated with the model exceed acceptable risk levels, the model is not deployed unless additional mitigation measures are implemented that sufficiently minimize risk.
response.note: Generic acceptance gate (E3), present-tense conditional rule (E1), C3(b). Mitigations themselves are 'appropriate safety mitigations' with nothing named (p.13).

acc_decider.note: Safety Advisory Group only gives 'recommendations' (p.13, p.19); board of OpenAI Ireland 'exercise systemic risk oversight' for EU purposes (p.20); approval for deployment is unattributed ('the model may be approved', p.13). Deployment governance is deferred to Appendix B of the PF, another document (A1).

acc_external.note: p.19 'We may solicit and obtain input from external experts ... This may include independent third-party evaluators, stress testing of safeguards' (hedged); p.13 external experts 'as available and appropriate'; p.17 external security assessments are undated present-tense practice about OpenAI's own security (E1).

acc_unmet.quote: For the EU Code of Practice, if we identify any instances of non-adherence or any measures that are required to be implemented to ensure continued adherence, we will draft and implement a remediation plan
acc_unmet.note: Framework-wide non-compliance procedure, limited to the EU Code; 'as appropriate' in the same sentence qualifies only the FGF update. The p.13 gate conditions only on risk being minimized (E4), so it is not counted here. Ambiguous fit to C6(b), which lists reporting, investigation or disclosure.

mentioned.quote: We principally build safeguards against biological and chemical threats, and we prioritize biological capability evaluations due to the higher potential severity of biological threats.
mentioned.note: CBRN also listed as a systemic risk category on p.6.

threshold.quote: The model can provide meaningful counterfactual assistance (relative to unlimited access to baseline of tools available in 2021) to novice actors (anyone with a basic relevant technical background) that enables them to create known biological or chemical threats.
threshold.note: CBRN Tier 2; Tier 3 on p.11. Tiers reviewed in the residual-risk acceptance decision (p.8).
